description: Estimated fast pusher installation standing in for the 90 mm ducted fan of 1.9-2.2 m, 3-4 kg electric jets: 36 mm class 1200 rpm/V outrunner, ideal ESC, 6S 3.3 Ah LiPo and a 7x5 pusher propeller in a slot behind the wing. Tuned with the runtime electric solver to the static thrust of a 6S 90 mm EDF (about 27.5 N, 2.8 kgf) with zero thrust near 61 m/s and a 249 m/s static tip speed; all values are engineering estimates, not a measured installation. Ducted-fan inlet, duct and exhaust effects are not modelled. Realism batch 2026-11-17: the 4S 70 mm class left 3.6-3.9 kg jets under the package's 0.5 thrust-to-weight minimum.

kv_rpm_per_volt.source: Engineering estimate for a 36 mm class 1200 rpm/V outrunner (no specific product verified); chosen so the static thrust matches a 6S 90 mm EDF (2.5-3.5 kgf)

resistance_ohm.source: Engineering estimate for a 36 mm class 1200 rpm/V outrunner (no specific product verified): winding resistance

no_load_current_a.source: Engineering estimate for a 36 mm class 1200 rpm/V outrunner (no specific product verified): no-load current

no_load_voltage_v.source: Engineering estimate for a 36 mm class 1200 rpm/V outrunner (no specific product verified): no-load test voltage

resistance_ohm.source: About 5 milliohm per cell for a 3300 mAh 35C pack (catalogue class)

auxiliary_current_a.source: Receiver, servos, retract and light electronics at rest

ocv_points.source: Linear 3.0 to 4.2 V per cell over state of charge, as in the 4S package

rotating_inertia.source: 8 g 7 in propeller as a slender rod m·D²/12 = 2.1e-5 plus a 36 mm motor bell

ct_table.source: Borrowed: nondimensional UIUC APC Sport 11x6 table (apcsp_11x6_static_rd0488.txt, apcsp_11x6_rd0495_6000.txt) applied to a 7x5 pusher (mirrored blades assumed equivalent) by T = Ct·ρ·n²·D⁴ and P = Cp·ρ·n³·D⁵: no UIUC table for this propeller is in the repository; P/D 0.71 against 0.55 and a lower chord Reynolds number make it an estimate

cp_table.source: Borrowed: nondimensional UIUC APC Sport 11x6 table (apcsp_11x6_static_rd0488.txt, apcsp_11x6_rd0495_6000.txt) applied to a 7x5 pusher (mirrored blades assumed equivalent) by T = Ct·ρ·n²·D⁴ and P = Cp·ρ·n³·D⁵: no UIUC table for this propeller is in the repository; P/D 0.71 against 0.55 and a lower chord Reynolds number make it an estimate

motor_behind_hub.source: Pusher: motor centre ahead of the propeller hub by a 0.01 m adapter plus half of a 0.05 m outrunner (applied forward)

firewall_behind_hub.source: Pusher: motor front face ahead of the propeller hub by a 0.01 m adapter plus a 0.05 m outrunner (applied forward)

spinner_length.source: Prop nut behind the hub, for the crash-hull tail point

mass.source: Engineering estimate for a 36 mm class 1200 rpm/V outrunner (no specific product verified): 36 mm class mass
7x5 propeller about 0.008 kg plus prop adapter

size.source: 7 in propeller envelope for intrinsic inertia
